execution_validity.design_limit: One fixed-order baseline-then-tail pair on known public games; equal engineering conditions do not remove model randomness or order effects.

baseline.new_calls_after_global_soft_end_semantic: Legacy shared-analysis field counts gate_admitted_return + chat_begin + http_attempt_begin; it is not a count of new model/HTTP requests. Use the three explicit late_* counters.

deadline.action_time_method: GameRun.started_at plus cumulative ActionRecord.wallclock_seconds; UTC alignment, not an instrumented action-start boundary.
deadline.evidence_boundary: The 256-event deadline deque intentionally evicts old passed checks. Aggregate counts survive; full no-new-client-request evidence comes from lossless inference-timing. Client admission does not guarantee server arrival before deadline or abort in-flight work.

scheduler.scope: Validates observed decisions and attribution; does not treat a changed ordering on a different trajectory as a causal score replay.
